Provides a resource to create CVM resource pool packs for advance compute resource pool management.

Resource pool packs allow users to purchase and manage compute resource pools in advance. This resource supports standard Terraform operations: create, read, and delete. Update operations are not available from CVM API, all field changes will trigger a destroy and recreate.

    period: 12,
    resourcePoolPackType: "EXCLUSIVE",
    autoPlacement: true,
    dedicatedResourcePoolPackName: "my-resource-pool",
    renewFlag: "NOTIFY_AND_MANUAL_RENEW",
});

## API Reference

This resource interacts with the following TencentCloud APIs:

* Create:
  - [DescribeResourcePoolPacks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/search/?wd=DescribeResourcePoolPacks&type=document&lang=en)
  - [PurchaseResourcePoolPacks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/search/?wd=PurchaseResourcePoolPacks&type=document&lang=en)
* Read: [DescribeResourcePoolPacks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/search/?wd=DescribeResourcePoolPacks&type=document&lang=en)
* Delete:
  - [DescribeResourcePoolPacks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/search/?wd=DescribeResourcePoolPacks&type=document&lang=en)
  - [TerminateResourcePoolPacks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/search/?wd=TerminateResourcePoolPacks&type=document&lang=en)

## Import



CVM resource pool packs can be imported using the resource pool pack ID, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cvm/resourcePoolPack:ResourcePoolPack pool_pack rpp-xxxxx
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
